tags.feature:
Undead State:
When players die and are revived in multiplayer, they are now restored in an undead state. Players are revived with full health but have a debuff that has them take 100% more damage and prevents them from being able to restore health. This can be removed by visiting a Healing room.
More room choices for combat encounters around gimmicks.
Gimmick rooms reward the players for completing them.

Chaos Mode:
Player’s equipped weapons shuffle between each other when opening a new chest.
When playing alone, your equipped weapons randomize when opening a chest.
Elite enemies are randomized.
More regular enemy variations.
Summons can now be picked up and thrown.

Throwing totems will explode once hitting walls and pillars. This ensures your totems are not thrown to awkward locations where they become out of play for too long, and will force them to respawn next to the player.
War Hammer.
Fire Fist.

Ice Fist.

War Spike.

Wanderer
Automatically revives into undead state on death, even in single player.
No penalties while in the undead state.

Suicide Bomber:
3 variations across different tiers and difficulties.

Human Followers:
Now have an undead state after being killed, turning them into a zombie that requires them to be killed again.
Added a magnet item that can be picked up in survivor mode which auto pickups all gold and experience active on the floor. Has a chance to drop from elite kills.
Added a revive item that restores undead state. Has a chance to drop from elite kills if a player is in the undead state.

Player Revive Rate Added.
Item Drop Chance Added.

notes.title: v0.8.0
notes.content:
v0.8.0

Changes:
-Increased the amount of gems (meta progression currency) rewarded by 25%
Removed 5 fight rooms in Standard & Daily challenge to shorten the time to complete a run by ~40%. (Planning a ‘Endless’ mode for those that want the longer experience)
-Moved in flyer’s spawn locations so they come into game play quicker.
-Dash Flame: Now has the Time tag. Dash flame’s active time can be increased with Time modifiers.
-Blue Dash Flame Modifier: Now adds 10% Time modifier
-Flash Flame Trail: Modifier: Now adds 10% Time modifier
-Unoriginal Modifier: Player level required to get access to modifier lowered from 6 to 0.
-Sword tag has been renamed to Blade.
-Dagger tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Dagger tag now have the Blade tag for better synergies.
-Axe tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Axe tag now have the Blade tag for better synergies.
-Missile tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Missile tag now have the Projectile tag for better synergies.
-Wand tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Wand tag now have the Staff tag for better synergies.
-Cannon tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Cannon tag now have the Bow tag for better synergies.
-Shield tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Shield tag now have the Bludgeon tag for better synergies.
-Fist tag has been removed. Any weapons that previously had the Fist tag now have the Bludgeon tag for better synergies.
-Blowgun now has the Staff tag.
-Holy Aura now has the Melee tag.
-Fire Aura now has the Magic tag.

Fixes:
-Reroll Upgrade - Purchasing the reroll upgrade now correctly adds a free reroll at time of purchase.
-Chinese (Simplified): Added more missing glyphs to the font sheet.
-Freeze Ability: Now works as intended with Follow Up attack Modifier.
-Holy Aura: Now works as intended with Follow Up attack Modifier.
-Rifle: Now works as intended with Follow Up attack Modifier.
-Fixed some issues where traps were placed underneath decals.

Quality Of Life:
-How to unlock descriptions are displayed in the character selection screen when highlighting an unknown locked character.

Misc:
Reset standard leaderboards due to big changes.
